test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

C sits fourth to the right of X. Only two people sit between Y and W when counted from the left of Y. D sits third to the left of B. A is an immediate neighbour of B and W. How many people between C and A when counted from the left of A?
solution:
Given:

Only two people sit between Y and W when counted from the left of Y. 

A is an immediate neighbour of B and W. Now we have 2 cases possible here,

Case 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daa6b7230710e11e64629cb5ae53860b7f306dfedfddf9219bb7cc1f0631912b.png] 

Case 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e9f27445a809c9b18eea29951df679093fe20ca5b3e25df53d0686a94f0da50.png] 

D sits third to the left of B. 

Case 1: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/407667a6403d0b7bd595f31e01b6ab110010ff4ad0e18dacf241891e8f104d0d.png] 

Case 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04c8557d36ed5c17a3986a043fcc6dde260fa75bbb2706a9f54c358f077407fe.png] 

C sits fourth to the right of X. 

Now, case 1 will be eliminated as there is no space for placing C and X.

Case 2: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0254c17d22647489044d3524f27696c0ef6a386be2f6eed401a342937868e44b.png] 

Thus, 4 people are between C and A when counted from the left of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
